title: BriefRequest
description: Request for the `brief` skill. The brief document itself is passed as an opaque object and validated against job-brief-v1 by the skill — not declared inline here, so there is exactly one place the JobBrief shape is defined.

jobId.description: The job this brief opens. Becomes a directory name under project-data/jobs/.

sourcePath.description: Where the brief was read from, recorded for provenance. Null when authored in-memory (e.g. by the .claude mirror from a conversational ask).

brief.description: The candidate JobBrief. Validated against job-brief-v1; envelope and briefId are filled in if absent.
